note: Rappahannock County (51157) zones its land under Chapter 170 (eCode360), but no county or town zoning district layer is published as a queryable GIS service. The county site's planning and zoning pages link only to ordinance text and a contact for map data. The Town of Washington publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (2022) and defers to its Zoning Administrator. ArcGIS Online searches found no official Rappahannock zoning layer. The Piedmont Data Viewer (PEC) covers neighbouring counties' zoning but not Rappahannock's. Only third-party parcel vendors mention zoning fields, and those are paid products.
